fields.certification: A Course Completion Certificate will be awarded at the end of the training by ITTI.
fields.course_overview: This customized training program is designed to elevate the professional behavior, customer service approach, and hospitality standards of support staff such as office boys and helpers. Through role-play, real-world scenarios, and hands-on demonstrations, participants will learn how to interact confidently, respectfully, and professionally in a corporate setting.
fields.learning_outcomes:
By the end of the training, participants will:

  • Demonstrate improved hospitality etiquette
  • Communicate respectfully with confidence
  • Understand the expectations of a professional workplace
  • Be equipped to handle guests and serve effectively
  • Represent the organization with better grooming and conduct
fields.training_methodology:
• Live Demonstrations
  • Role-play & Simulated Scenarios
  • Group Discussions & Reflection
  • Trainer Feedback & Daily Recap
  • Final Assessment with Verbal Feedback
